controls: Reset independent counter per trial. Server increments before closing without response; an independent GET reads the resulting counter.
disproof: No client response error, effect not committed, reset/query fails, or counts do not correspond to observed attempts; mark inconclusive instead of claiming the mechanism.
hypothesis: Dropping the HTTP response after a side effect leaves the client without success evidence; blind replay can duplicate the effect.
limitations: Synthetic local HTTP fault injection, not OI relay or WAN
Does not prove all retries are unsafe
